blocks.caption: Palace tells Velasco to face probe; houses raided

blocks.text: Palace tells Velasco to face probe; houses raided

Malacañang has advised former House speaker Lord Allan Velasco to come forward and shed light on the allegations against him after the Bureau of Immigration (BI) confirmed that he left the country on Aug. 30 and did not come home on his expected date of return.?

blocks.caption: BI, NBI confirm Velasco, wife out of Philippines

blocks.text: BI, NBI confirm Velasco, wife out of Philippines
Former House speaker Lord Allan Velasco boarded a flight to Japan on Aug. 30 and did not fly back to Manila on Sept. 14, his expected date of return, the Bureau of Immigration confirmed yesterday.

blocks.text: Hair pulling at NAIA: BI orders 2 officers to explain

The Bureau of Immigration yesterday confirmed that two female BI officers at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport figured in a verbal tussle that escalated into slapping, pushing and hair pulling on Tuesday, in full view of passengers arriving at the NAIA Terminal 3.
